newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex approves share buyback scheme.
newsitem.headline: Cemex approves share buyback scheme.

text.p: Mexican construction company Cemex SA said on Monday its board of directors had approved a share buyback plan worth up to $200 million.
It said in a statement the plan still had to be approved by company shareholders during a meeting on April 24.
Cemex said it will buy back at least $115 million worth of shares, minus the amount of money it uses to pay dividends during the period of the buyback.
The cement company, the world's fourth largest, said it would buy back shares either on the primary market, or in private transactions according to market conditions.
It said it would fund the buyback program with cash flow from existing operations.
